chunks: He (peace be upon him) said, having returned from Siffin and approached the graves on the outskirts of Kufa:
O residents of lonely dwellings, of desolate places, and of dark graves. O people of the dust, O people of strangeness, O people of solitude, O people of wilderness.
You are forerunners and predecessors to us, and we are followers following you.
As for the houses, they have been inhabited; as for the wives, they have been married; as for the wealth, it has been distributed.
This is the news of what is with us; so what is the news of what is with you?

key_terms.صِفِّينَ: Site of the Battle of Siffin between Imam Ali and Muawiyah

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali say to the dead in the graves of Kufa upon returning from Siffin?
ai.summary: Delivered upon Imam Ali’s return from the Battle of Siffin, this address to the graves of Kufa serves as a profound meditation on the transient nature of worldly life (fana) and the certainty of the Hereafter. It highlights the Shia concept of the 'preceding generation' of martyrs and ancestors as spiritual forerunners, emphasizing the continuity between the living and the dead in the journey toward divine truth.
